chambers.name: Full-Bore Chamber
chambers.description: The Full-Bore Chamber is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Fires a piercing bolt in a line, dealing damage that falls as it travels.
Empowered: Deals greatly increased damage and pushes the slayer backwards.

chambers.name: Marksman Chamber
chambers.description: The Marksman Chamber is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Fires a shot in a line, dealing 350 damage to the first Behemoth hit. If a part is struck, that part takes 25% more damage from Shots for 10 seconds.
Empowered: Damage bonus increased to 60%, and 25% to all allies.

chambers.name: Salvo Chamber
chambers.description: The Salvo Chamber is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Fires an explosive missile in a line, dealing 450 damage in an area upon impact.
Empowered: Fires 3 missiles in a spread.

grips.name: Captain's Grip
grips.description: The Captain's Grip is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Launches a collectible buff a short distance, granting 15% increased attack speed for 15 seconds when collected.
Empowered: Grants the same buff to all Slayers.

grips.name: Saboteur's Grip
grips.description: The Saboteur's Grip is part of a craftable weapon in Dauntless.
partEffect: Launches an explosive mine that deals 400 damage. Mine charges after a short period, increasing damage to 700.
Empowered: Deals 900 damage when charged and can interrupt Behemoths.

mods.name: Capacitive Magazine
partEffect: Using an ability returns 8 standard ammo to the magazine.

mods.name: Demolition Sights
partEffect: While empowered, deal +100% damage to objects created by Behemoths.

mods.name: Extraction Catalyst
partEffect: Reduce both ability cooldowns by 2 seconds when dodging through Behemoth attacks.

mods.name: Lightweight Frame
partEffect: Gain 20% increased movespeed when at 6 or less ammo.

mods.name: Lucky Magazine
partEffect: Grants 2% critical strike chance for each round missing from the magazine.

mods.name: Precision Sights
partEffect: Deal 8 increased damage when attacking the same part multiple times. Stacks up to 5 times.

mods.name: Tactician's Magazine
partEffect: Empowered Reloading at exactly 0 ammo decreases the cooldown of both abilities by 4 seconds.
